responsibility: Declares a quiet-mode wrapper around the compiler’s lightweight formatted printing routines. The exported `qprintf*` procedures mirror the small `M2Printf` API but are intended for optional status output that should disappear when the global quiet option is enabled.
same_name_distinction: This `.def` file only declares the quiet-aware `qprintf*` wrapper API, whereas the same-name `.mod` file supplies the policy implementation that checks `M2Options.Quiet` before forwarding to `M2Printf`.
